newsitem.title: USA: Schlumberger net up on oilfield gains.
newsitem.headline: Schlumberger net up on oilfield gains.

text.p: Schlumberger Ltd on Thursday reported third quarter net income rose 36 percent to $229 million, citing the broad strength of its oilfield results.

"On the other hand, Measurement & Systems' seasonally slow third quarter was further impacted by a temporary weakness in the semiconductor industry and continued turbulence in electricity metering markets, the company said. "The overall results of this group will, however, improve as market conditions stabilize and the measures which we announced during the quarter take effect."
The company said operating revenue of $2.26 billion was 18 percent above third quarter 1995. Oilfield Services revenue increased 28 percent, while the worldwide rig count rose nine percent.
All businesses contributed to the 68 percent growth in operating income, Schlumberger said.

Measurement & Systems revenue decreased 1 percent compared to the same period last year, as gains in Electronic Transactions were offset by a decline in the Metering business and Automatic Test Equipment.
